annotation.summary_en: KOSHA technical guideline (M-61-2017) under Korea's Occupational Safety and Health Standards Rules Art. 222, setting safety requirements for selecting, installing, using, inspecting and training workers on industrial robots, including emergency stops, guarding, teaching-mode safeguards, inspections and record keeping.
annotation.title_clean: 산업용 로봇의 사용 등에 관한 안전 기술지침 (KOSHA GUIDE M-61-2017)
annotation.title_en: Technical Safety Guideline on the Use of Industrial Robots (KOSHA GUIDE M-61-2017)
annotation.venue: Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency
key_provisions_or_claims: Robots must have emergency stop devices and automatic stop on power, control or equipment faults, with manual restart required.
Teaching mode must automatically reduce manipulator speed and force; enabling switches stop robot when released.
Employers must install guards, interlocked fences, light curtains, ropes or watchers to prevent contact within the operating range.
Work inside the operating range requires written work rules, lockout signage, and pre-work checks.
Daily and periodic inspections, records kept 3+ years, and special safety training for robot workers.
